descriptions.skill: Runtime-driven code-quality audit — a single auditor role reviews a code artifact against a written rulebook (compliance rules, staleness signals, gap heuristics, test-integrity checks) under a deterministic runtime. Use when auditing code for quality, reviewing a diff against code-quality-standards, checking conventions on a PR, or "audit code quality". Also use after writing or modifying code to verify it meets the team's defensive-code-anti-pattern rules. Dispatched by /gauntlet for code-pr and code-local artifacts. Requires Node >= 22.

roles.auditor: Code-quality auditor that reviews a code artifact against a written rulebook — compliance rules, staleness signals, gap heuristics, and test-integrity checks — reporting rule-anchored findings with warnings-and-gaps character. Runs only inside the code-quality-audit skill's runtime-driven handshake, in a fresh isolated dispatch — never invoked standalone.
